Daniel kneels on his knees in prayer (Dan 6:10), while elsewhere the word expresses praise and blessing directed to God (Dan 2:19–20; 4:34). The Spanish glosses reveal this duality clearly: 'arrodillado' (kneeling) alongside 'bendije/bendijo' (I blessed/he blessed). That a single root spans prostrate prayer posture and exalted doxology captures something profound about biblical worship—blessing God begins with bending the knee."
